faculty.name: Prof. Martin Dupont
faculty.bio: Former senior engineer at a major French tech company who returned to academia to share what he learned building high-scale systems. His algorithms class is famous for its challenging problem sets that actually prepare you for technical interviews.

faculty.name: Dr. Sophie Laurent
faculty.bio: PhD from a top French research university, followed by research stints at labs in London and Montreal. Now splits time between teaching and an active research program focused on ethical AI.

faculty.name: Dr. Karim Benali
faculty.bio: Spent five years at a European cybersecurity firm before joining academia. Brings real incident response experience into the classroom — his security lectures draw from actual case studies with permission.

faculty.name: Prof. Claire Moreau
faculty.bio: Built production web systems for a decade before realizing she missed teaching. Now runs our full-stack development sequence, where students build and deploy real applications.
